portfolio_decision.production_boundary: This is not a production quote, a quality result, or evidence of warm-start/recovery semantics. Any placement claim above $1.10/hour requires materially longer or near-saturated sessions, lower retry loss, or a measured lifecycle reduction.
portfolio_decision.reason: At $1.10/hour, an 8-hour session at 90% productive utilization and 5% retry loss is below target; the same is true at $1.00/hour. The bound fails for a 2-hour session and does not support $1.25/hour at that representative envelope.
